mentions.name: Churchit
mentions.description: A fully free and open-source church management platform designed as a comprehensive all-in-one solution that churches can self-host with minimal technical expertise. It provides a dynamic public website, a member portal, and a feature-rich management backend.
mentions.audience: Churches that want to self-host a management platform with minimal technical expertise
mentions.source_excerpt: A fully FOSS Church management platform called Churchit ( https://Churchit.app ).
mentions.author: meichthys
